cues.S01: Imagine a hospital loses power. Some status reports arrive. Others are missing. What can the crisis team actually know?
cues.S02: In a crisis, decisions often depend on incomplete information. A missing report does not tell us whether a service is working. CIRA helps us study what can be recovered from the information we have, and what remains unknown. We do this in a controlled experiment with a completely synthetic service model.
cues.S03: There are three parts. Ground Truth is the complete state of our synthetic experiment. Observation is the information we allow the AI to see. Reconstruction is what the AI can recover from that information. The AI never receives Ground Truth. We keep it separate so we can evaluate the result afterwards. That lets us measure how much the AI recovered, how closely it matches the original, and what remains unresolved. Here is CIRA.
cues.F1: This recording shows an engine result. On the left is Ground Truth, created for this experiment. Observation contains only the information made available to the AI. The two views let us see the difference between what exists and what is known.
cues.F2: Now we can examine the Reconstruction. CIRA keeps the results of its different reconstruction methods separate and shows the combined result in violet. We can compare it with the information the AI received and with Ground Truth, without mixing them together.
cues.F3: Some values may remain unknown. CIRA keeps those visible. Coverage tells us how much was recovered. Accuracy tells us how closely the recovered information matches Ground Truth. Each measure has its own basis, so we can understand the result in context.
cues.F4: Each result is linked to the experiment that produced it. This makes the result traceable. In civilian crisis management, information like this could support human decisions. The decision itself remains with the people responsible. Our demonstration uses only synthetic data.
cues.S05: For crisis management, CIRA explores how to make incomplete information more useful while keeping uncertainty visible. For AI research, it gives us a way to study how reconstruction changes when the available information changes. We can measure what the AI recovers.
cues.S06: CIRA. Understanding incomplete information. CIRA — Powered by SYNTX.
